name: non-market-certification
on:
  push:
    branches: [cert/non-market-e2e-20260922, repair/market-scope-efficiency-final-20260923, cert/profitability-portfolio-autonomy-current-v1, cert/profitability-portfolio-autonomy-final-v1]
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ''
      preserved_only:
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: non-market-certification-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  durability-prerequisites:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[non-market-cert]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Enforce dispatch commit pin before running code
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || '' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          if [ -n "$EXPECTED_SHA" ]; then test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"; fi
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12.14'
      - run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m certification.run prepare --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes"
      - name: Verify complete build identity before expensive gates
        run: >-
          python -m certification.build_consistency verify
          --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes"
          --expected-sha "$GITHUB_SHA"
          --output non-market-evidence/build-preflight.json
      - run: mkdir -p non-market-evidence
      - name: Ten-minute mature Solana retention and source-clock pressure
        timeout-minutes: 13
        run: |
          mkdir -p non-market-evidence/run381-pressure
          python -m certification.run381_pressure --measured-contention --output non-market-evidence/run381-pressure > non-market-evidence/run381-pressure/run.log 2>&1
      - name: Combined mature source backlog reader checkpoint and control pressure
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          python -m certification.combined_observer --output non-market-evidence/combined-pressure > non-market-evidence/combined-pressure.log 2>&1
      - name: Joined eight-day PAPER campaign and recovery/provider gates
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}
          MM_TEST_LANE_WORKTREES: ${{ runner.temp }}/non-market-lanes
        run: |
          python -m certification.joined_soak --sources "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes" --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/joined-soak" > non-market-evidence/joined-soak.log 2>&1
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/joined-soak/result.json" non-market-evidence/joined-soak.json
          python -m certification.joined_acceptance --sources "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes" --soak "$RUNNER_TEMP/joined-soak" --output non-market-evidence/joined
      - name: Preserve joined native predecessors
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/joined-soak" ]; then
            tar -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" -czf non-market-evidence/joined-native-predecessors.tar.gz joined-soak
          fi
      - name: Preserve exact-SHA durability evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: non-market-durability-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: non-market-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
  offline-prerequisites:
    needs: durability-prerequisites
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[non-market-cert]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Enforce dispatch commit pin before running code
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || '' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          if [ -n "$EXPECTED_SHA" ]; then test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"; fi
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12.14'
      - run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m certification.run prepare --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes"
      - name: Verify complete build identity before expensive gates
        run: >-
          python -m certification.build_consistency verify
          --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes"
          --expected-sha "$GITHUB_SHA"
          --output non-market-evidence/build-preflight.json
      - name: Restore same-run exact-SHA durability evidence
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PYCODE'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import shutil
          from certification.autonomous_control import _artifact_metadata
          from certification.autonomous_window import extract_artifact
          from certification.prospective_program import GitHub
          api = GitHub()
          run_id = int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'])
          run = api.request('GET', f'actions/runs/{run_id}')
          if (run['head_sha'] != os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
                  or str(run['run_attempt']) != os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']):
              raise ValueError('durability_run_identity')
          jobs = api.pages(f'actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{run["run_attempt"]}/jobs', 'jobs')
          proof = [j for j in jobs if j['name'].split(' / ')[-1] == 'durability-prerequisites']
          if len(proof) != 1 or proof[0]['conclusion'] != 'success':
              raise ValueError('durability_job_not_passed')
          name = f'non-market-durability-{run["head_sha"]}-{run["run_attempt"]}'
          reference = _artifact_metadata(api, run_id, name)
          source = extract_artifact(api, reference, Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'durability-evidence')
          shutil.copytree(source, 'non-market-evidence', dirs_exist_ok=True)
          PYCODE
      - name: Verify frozen profitability portfolio autonomy protocol
        run: python -m certification.protocol_freeze --output non-market-evidence/profitability-protocol-freeze.json
      - name: Reject retired provider references in prepared runtime
        run: >-
          python -m certification.provider_removal_gate
          --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pump"
          --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/meteora"
          --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pons"
          --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/ramses"
          --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/certification"
          --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/workflows"
      - name: Preserve prepared runtime sources for repair inspection
        run: |
          mkdir -p non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/{pump,pons,meteora,ramses}
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pump/tests/pump_acceleration_natural_prospective.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/pump/
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pump/meme_machine/pump_acceleration_paper.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/pump/
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pump/meme_machine/pump_paper_accounting.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/pump/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pons/robinhood_research/pons_selective_cohort.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/pons/
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pons/robinhood_research/pons_selective_paper.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/pons/
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pons/robinhood_research/pons_selective_capital.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/pons/
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/meteora/tests/solana_dlmm_independent_v1.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/meteora/
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/meteora/meme_machine/dlmm_independent_accounting.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/meteora/
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/ramses/robinhood_research/ramses_extended_test.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/ramses/
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/ramses/robinhood_research/ramses_campaign_capital.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/ramses/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/ramses/robinhood_research/ramses_strategy_ledger.py" non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/ramses/
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/meteora" diff --binary HEAD > non-market-evidence/prepared-sources/meteora/git-diff.patch
      - name: Supervisor, source mutation and terminal truth
        env:
          MM_TEST_LANE_WORKTREES: ${{ runner.temp }}/non-market-lanes
        run: |
          mkdir -p non-market-evidence
          set -o pipefail
          python -m unittest discover -s certification/tests -v 2>&1 | tee non-market-evidence/supervisor.log
      - name: Four parallel offline component suites
        run: python -m certification.non_market --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes" --output non-market-evidence/offline
      - name: Native ledger SIGKILL matrix
        run: |
          python -m certification.crash_matrix --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-crash" > non-market-evidence/crash.log
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-crash/result.json" non-market-evidence/crash.json
      - name: Four-lane restart safety contract
        run: python -m certification.restart_safety --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes" --output non-market-evidence/restart-safety
      - name: Integrated current-policy four-lane acceptance
        run: python -m certification.integrated_acceptance --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes" --output non-market-evidence/integrated-acceptance
      - name: Resource gates
        run: |
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/pump" && python -m tests.resource_check) > non-market-evidence/pump-resource.json
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/meteora" && python -m tests.resource_check) > non-market-evidence/meteora-resource.json
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/meteora" && python -m tests.dlmm_resource_check) > non-market-evidence/meteora-dlmm-resource.json
      - name: Prepare original historical Meteora accounting implementation
        run: |
          git worktree add --detach "$RUNNER_TEMP/historical-meteora" 3370a0a3a283b4e3901ae51e294eeb00ef69832d
          git show 307b005d4042bafa5cfb9952cd60ab978282bd85:certification/patches/meteora-checkpoint.patch > "$RUNNER_TEMP/historical-meteora.patch"
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/historical-meteora" apply --index "$RUNNER_TEMP/historical-meteora.patch"
      - name: Digest-pinned historical exposure inventory
        timeout-minutes: 3
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >-
          python -m certification.historical_inventory
          --artifact-id 10719564489
          --sha256 b3a2c00fc9cb97ac40d83c320ea8cea18015daa7d9d5144dbcde4eeb3da2dfff
          --output non-market-evidence/historical-inventory.json
          --native-meteora-root "$RUNNER_TEMP/historical-meteora"
      - name: Conservative historical Meteora resolution proof
        timeout-minutes: 3
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >-
          python -m certification.historical_resolution
          --artifact-id 10719564489
          --sha256 b3a2c00fc9cb97ac40d83c320ea8cea18015daa7d9d5144dbcde4eeb3da2dfff
          --native-meteora-root "$RUNNER_TEMP/historical-meteora"
          --expected-journal-hash e6e90ee486dd9e22fc394e108fb24371e5247a1b71023ed9846714069380e2f0
          --expected-reason dlmm_terminal_state_disagrees_with_forward_reconstruction:token_x_mint_info
          --output non-market-evidence/historical-resolution.json
      - name: Check for competing market jobs before connectivity
        if: inputs.preserved_only != true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python -m certification.guard --wait-seconds 0
      - name: Secret-safe Solana and Robinhood chain binding
        if: inputs.preserved_only != true
        env:
          MM_SOLANA_READ_RPC_URL: ${{ secrets.MM_SOLANA_READ_RPC_URL }}
          MM_ROBINHOOD_READ_RPC_URL: ${{ secrets.MM_ROBINHOOD_READ_RPC_URL }}
          MM_ROBINHOOD_DLMM_RPC_URL: ${{ secrets.MM_ROBINHOOD_DLMM_RPC_URL }}
        run: python -m certification.chain_binding --output non-market-evidence/chain-binding.json
      - name: Short production-adapter connectivity probes without paper entries
        if: inputs.preserved_only != true
        timeout-minutes: 3
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}
          MM_SOLANA_READ_RPC_URL: ${{ secrets.MM_SOLANA_READ_RPC_URL }}
          MM_ROBINHOOD_READ_RPC_URL: ${{ secrets.MM_ROBINHOOD_READ_RPC_URL }}
          MM_ROBINHOOD_DISCOVERY_RPC_URL: ${{ secrets.MM_ROBINHOOD_DISCOVERY_RPC_URL }}
          MM_ROBINHOOD_DLMM_RPC_URL: ${{ secrets.MM_ROBINHOOD_DLMM_RPC_URL }}
        run: |
          failed=0
          for lane in pump pons meteora ramses; do
            (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes/$lane" && python "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/certification/connectivity_smoke.py" --lane "$lane" --output "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/non-market-evidence/$lane-connectivity.json") || failed=1
          done
          exit "$failed"
      - name: Six active regimes and bounded preserved evidence
        if: inputs.preserved_only == true
        run: |
          python -m certification.directional_acceptance --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes" --output non-market-evidence/directional-acceptance
          python -m certification.directional_preserved_validation --worktrees "$RUNNER_TEMP/non-market-lanes" --output non-market-evidence/preserved-validation.json
      - name: Aggregate final non-market engineering certification
        run: >-
          python -m certification.final_acceptance
          --evidence non-market-evidence
          --expected-sha "${{ github.sha }}"
          ${{ inputs.preserved_only && '--preserved-only' || '' }}
          --output non-market-evidence/final-acceptance.json
      - name: Preserve success and failure evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: non-market-certification-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            non-market-evidence/
            certification-preflight.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

name: Stage E exact-candidate observer v2
run-name: Observer v2 on the meme machine — ${{ inputs.expected_sha }}
'on':
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        type: string
        required: true
permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: meme-machine-stage-e-observer
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  observer:
    if: ${{ github.run_attempt == 1 }}
    runs-on:
    - self-hosted
    - linux
    - x64
    - meme-machine-stage-e-observer
    timeout-minutes: 720
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      with:
        ref: ${{ inputs.expected_sha }}
        fetch-depth: 0
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Verify exact host and mounted volume before observer preparation
      env:
        OBSERVER_EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha }}
        OBSERVER_IDENTITY_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/observer-final-host-${{ github.run_id }}
      run: python3 -I -B diagnostics/stage-e-observer-v2-self-hosted/inspect_host.py
    - name: Publish NEW executable declaration and read it back before Trial 1
      id: declaration
      env:
        GH_OBSERVER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        OBSERVER_EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha }}
      run: python3 -I -B diagnostics/stage-e-observer-v2-self-hosted/launch_control.py configure
    - name: Preserve declaration before any measured interval
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: observer-predeclaration-${{ github.run_id }}-1
        path: '/mnt/volume_nyc1_1790918115030/ov2/r${{ github.run_id }}/PREDECLARATION*.json

          /mnt/volume_nyc1_1790918115030/ov2/r${{ github.run_id }}/READY.json

          ${{ runner.temp }}/observer-final-host-${{ github.run_id }}/HOST_IDENTITY.json'
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 90
    - name: Trial 1 of 6 — baseline; no warmup or retry
      id: trial1
      run: python3 -I -B diagnostics/stage-e-observer-v2-self-hosted/launch_control.py trial --sequence 1
    - name: Preserve Trial 1 raw evidence after all measured processes stop
      id: preserve1
      if: ${{ always() && steps.trial1.outcome != 'skipped' }}
      run: python3 -I -B diagnostics/stage-e-observer-v2-self-hosted/launch_control.py preserve --sequence 1
    - name: Upload Trial 1 outside its measured interval
      id: upload1
      if: ${{ always() && steps.preserve1.outcome == 'success' && steps.trial1.outcome != 'skipped' }}
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: observer-trial-1-${{ github.run_id }}-1
        path: '/mnt/volume_nyc1_1790918115030/ov2/r${{ github.run_id }}/TRIAL-1.tar.gz

          /mnt/volume_nyc1_1790918115030/ov2/r${{ github.run_id }}/INVENTORY-1.json'
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 90
        compression-level: 0
    - name: Read back Trial 1 artifact identity before advancing
      id: durable1
      if: ${{ always() && steps.upload1.outcome == 'success' }}
      env:
        GH_OBSERVER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        OBSERVER_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ steps.upload1.outputs.artifact-id }}
        OBSERVER_ARTIFACT_DIGEST: ${{ steps.upload1.outputs.artifact-digest }}

    - name: Preserve Trial 2 raw evidence after all measured processes stop

      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:

        path: '/mnt/volume_nyc1_1790918115030/ov2/r${{ github.run_id }}/TRIAL-2.tar.gz

        if-no-files-found: error
